text: いちばん　まえの　ポケモンに　もたせると　やせいポケモンが　でて　きにくくなる。

structure.jp: いちばん　まえの　ポケモンに　もたせると
structure.en: if you have the Pokémon at the very front hold it

structure.jp: やせいポケモンが　でて　きにくくなる。
structure.en: wild Pokémon become less likely to come out

patterns.name: 〜にくい
patterns.span: でて　きにくくなる
patterns.explanation: にくい added to a verb says it is hard to do or unlikely to happen, and くなる after it means 'gets to be that way'. でて きにくくなる = 'become less likely to come out'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: Changing a verb's ending to せる means making or letting someone do it. ポケモンに もたせる = 'have a Pokémon hold it'.

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a verb says that whenever this happens, the next thing follows. もたせると = 'when you have it hold this'.
